name: speech-scripted
description: Speech to text for tests: replays the lines of the file LEYDEC_SPEECH_SCRIPT names, one per over, and sends nothing anywhere

fields.name: text
fields.description: what the speech engine heard, as it wrote it

fields.name: language
fields.description: the language the engine transcribed, as an ISO 639-1 code

fields.name: model
fields.description: the model that produced the text

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: the engine's own confidence in the text, 0 to 1, when it reports one

fields.name: callsigns
fields.description: callsigns in the text, comma-separated: a pattern match over the normalised text (prefix, one digit, 1 to 3 letters; a 4-letter suffix such as N0CALL is not matched), not a decoded identity
